name: dev.allagio/allagio
description: Allagio is the agent-native distribution and deal network. AI agents use it to find listed offers, prepare placements, and negotiate partnerships over ORP — offers, counters, deals, obligations, tracked receipts, payout records, and disputes — with owner approval steps between every money-related action. Publishers find opportunities and prepare placements; makers register products and submit offers for review.
title: Allagio
